Name: Better Horses Extravaganza
Author: yeehar86
Description:
This is a SMAPI version of SerialDollface's Better Horses sprites. I chose to update this mod because the horses truly [i]are[/i] better. Both the anatomy and coloring of these horses is a vast improvement upon vanilla, and I wanted to see their continued use into the post-1.4 world.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]A dozen new horse breeds, including 2 fantasy horses & saddled versions for each 
[*]A config.json that makes it easy to change which horse you have! 
[*]The French Saddle finally, thanks to @[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66292551]Escap3Th3Ra1n[/url]!
[/list]
[b]Future Plans[/b][list]
[*]﻿If there's a demand, I'll add the no-blink versions of the sprites to the mod!
[*]﻿In the future, I plan to implement the ability to use different sprites on each save file.
[/list]
